name: Quietus — 3 Advanced — Songs of Distant Vitae

system.description: Believed to originate with Haqim's judges as a punishment for Cainites who fed improperly or cruelly, this power invokes residual impressions of emotion and memory carried in vitae, overwhelming the victim with terrifying "remembered" images and sensations drawn from his past vessels. You touch your target and spend a turn in concentration, then spend three Mental Traits and enter a Mental Challenge (retest Intimidation) against the victim. If the target has committed diablerie within the past week, you win all ties. If you win, you may spend up to three Mental Traits beyond the challenge cost; for each Trait spent this way the victim loses one Blood Trait as blood pours from his body in crimson tears, and he suffers escalating effects: at 1 Mental Trait, a five-minute flashback to his last feeding during which he must bid an additional Trait in all challenges; at 2 Mental Traits, a montage of past feedings that forces a Courage Test (difficulty 4 Traits) to avoid instant Rötschreck, plus bidding an additional Trait and losing ties for an hour even on success; at 3 Mental Traits, a nightmarish reenactment of every feeding he has ever committed from the victims' perspective, forcing a Self-Control Test (difficulty 5 Traits) or torpor for 10 minus half his Physical Traits, after which he loses half his permanent Willpower and gains the derangement Sanguinary Animism — even on success he enters Rötschreck for the rest of the night (his own reflection becomes his greatest fear), and at night's end must win (not merely tie) a Simple Test or lose a permanent Willpower Trait and gain Sanguinary Animism.
